Noticing your thoughts is part of the practice.

Kevin Trudeau says that when you realize you are thinking, you should not criticize yourself, judge, or get frustrated. He says you should have no emotion about it, and that this moment is meditation.

The thoughts will come up, and being aware of them is part of the process itself.

How do you usually react when your mind wanders?
